checks.name: JWT tokens used for authentication
checks.details: Verify: Tokens follow JWT standard with proper claims (exp, iat, sub)

checks.name: Resource ownership validation
checks.details: Verify: Users can only access their own resources (prescriptions, orders, etc.)

checks.name: Encryption at rest (database)
checks.details: Verify: Sensitive columns encrypted with AES-256 (SSN, medical records, payment info)

checks.name: Sensitive data not leaked in errors
checks.details: Error messages do not leak sensitive data

checks.name: Authentication failure logging
checks.details: Verify: Winston/Morgan logs contain failed authentication attempts with user ID, IP, timestamp

checks.name: PHI access logging (HIPAA requirement)
checks.details: Verify: Audit logs contain all PHI access events (user, resource, timestamp, action)

checks.name: Audit log integrity
checks.details: Verify: Audit logs use append-only table, no DELETE permissions, include checksums

requirements.name: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
requirements.details: Verify: RBAC implemented for all PHI access

requirements.name: Minimum necessary standard
requirements.details: Verify: Users only receive minimum necessary PHI

requirements.name: Workforce training
requirements.details: Verify: All workforce members trained on HIPAA requirements

requirements.name: Access controls
requirements.details: Verify: Unique user identification, emergency access procedures

requirements.name: Audit controls
requirements.details: Verify: All PHI access logged, logs retained 6+ years

requirements.name: Breach notification procedures
requirements.details: Verify: Procedures in place for 60-day notification, breach log maintained

requirements.name: Right to Access (Art. 15)
requirements.details: Verify: Endpoint exists for patients to access their data (GET /api/patient/data)

requirements.name: Right to Rectification (Art. 16)
requirements.details: Verify: Patients can update their personal data (PUT /api/patient/profile)

requirements.name: Right to Data Portability (Art. 20)
requirements.details: Verify: Data export in machine-readable format (JSON/XML/CSV)

requirements.name: Consent recording
requirements.details: Verify: All consents logged with who, when, what, how

requirements.name: Consent withdrawal
requirements.details: Verify: Consent can be withdrawn as easily as granted

requirements.name: Privacy by default
requirements.details: Verify: Most privacy-friendly settings by default

requirements.name: Pseudonymization
requirements.details: Verify: Patient IDs used instead of names in logs

MEDIUM: Verify authentication failure logging in production logs
